creative_brief.source: news: China investigates DeepSeek and Moonshot after Anthropic accuses them of secretly routing requests to Claude; 23M+12M alleged exchanges; sensitive-data concern; unresolved, nothing proven
creative_brief.topic: secret AI request routing and cross-border data investigation
creative_brief.thesis: The image is really about hidden diversion behind rival facades under unresolved scrutiny.
creative_brief.abstract_concept: Classical conduit logic applied to secret data rerouting across a border
creative_brief.visual_metaphor: A monumental engraved aqueduct-manifold with twin pavilion-server towers secretly diverting glowing scroll-streams through hidden copper tubes beneath a border wall into a veiled oracle head, watched by a giant inspector seal-magnifier
creative_brief.image_goal: News editorial hero communicating alleged secret rerouting and investigation without depicting real logos, persons, or verdicts

art_direction.historical_language: Roman aqueduct-manifold, copperplate city plan, wax inspection seals, veiled classical oracle head, engraved scrolls
art_direction.contemporary_language: twin server-towers, fiber and copper tubes, glowing exchange streams, inspector magnifier-lens
art_direction.medium: mixed-media editorial collage, copperplate etching plus halftone screen print
art_direction.rendering_language: cross-hatched stone and iron with stippled scroll paper and halftone stream glow
art_direction.composition_language: F diagrammatic-editorial-collage, cutaway manifold with hidden tubes crossing under a border wall
art_direction.color_strategy: electric-blue network void dominant, black-cream engraved hero, acid-yellow accent on diverted streams and seal
art_direction.texture_strategy: dense cross-hatching, fine engraving lines, stipple dots, halftone, paper grain, screen-print misregistration

visual_spec.hero_subject: monumental engraved aqueduct-manifold block with twin pavilion-server towers, cut open to reveal hidden copper tubes diverting glowing scroll-streams sideways
supporting_elements: glowing scroll-exchange streams flowing through exposed tubes
a segmented border wall with wax inspection seals straddling the tubes
a veiled classical oracle head receiving the diverted streams at right
a giant inspector seal-magnifier hovering top-left over the junction
visual_spec.environment: saturated electric-blue network void with faint copperplate diagram grid and drifting paper flecks
visual_spec.composition: Pattern F: hero manifold center-left at 65% scale, hidden tubes running diagonally under the border wall to the veiled head at right edge, seal-magnifier top-left counterweight, blue negative space top-right, eye path towers to tubes to oracle head
visual_spec.spatial_relationships: foreground manifold cutaway, midground border wall crossing diagonally, background veiled receiver head; magnifier overlaps top-left corner
visual_spec.perspective: straight-on diagrammatic poster view with cutaway depth, deep apparent focus
visual_spec.lighting: directional graphic light left, black ink shadow masses inside cutaway, symbolic glow from diverted streams
visual_spec.color_hierarchy: saturated blue ground, black-cream hero ironwork and scrolls, acid-yellow accent confined to diverted streams and seal ring
visual_spec.atmosphere: tense still diagram air, quiet before verdict
visual_spec.negative_space: electric-blue void top-right for headline breathing room

non_negotiables: old x new tension (aqueduct x server routing)

prompt_strategy.reason: FLUX sweet spot 30-80 words front-loaded; news needs precise spatial relations without bloat
prompt_strategy.model_specific_strategy: flux: front-load manifold-towers diversion, HEX bound to objects, natural sentences, no negative prompt
